name: LightSail
description: 3U technology demonstration of a solar sail, crowdfunded citizen space exploration.
explanation: Solar sail deployment and propulsion technology demonstration in low Earth orbit.

name: KickSat
description: 3U technology demo mothership deploying 104 tiny Sprite chip satellites.
explanation: Femtosatellite deployment system validating distributed sensor swarms.

name: STMSat-1
description: 1U education mission photographing Earth; first CubeSat built by a primary school.
explanation: 1U camera payload transmitting Earth imagery to ground stations.

name: TJ3Sat
description: Education mission with a voice synthesizer; first high-school-built CubeSat.
explanation: High school satellite testing voice synthesizers and amateur radio communications.

name: BisonSat
description: Earth science: imagery at 100 m or better using passive magnetic stabilization.
explanation: Tribal college mission validating passive stabilization for high-resolution Earth photography.

name: MinXSS
description: Solar flare and Sun X-ray science investigating coronal heating mechanisms.
explanation: 3U solar observatory measuring soft X-ray spectrum of flares.

name: CADRE
description: Space weather investigation in the thermosphere and ionosphere.
explanation: Upper atmosphere ion and neutral particle density sensor array.

name: IceCube
description: Test a sub-millimeter-wave radiometer to sense cloud ice at 5 to 15 km altitude.
explanation: High-frequency radiometer evaluating atmospheric cloud ice distribution.

name: HaloSat
description: Map hot gas in the Milky Way halo using soft X-ray spectroscopy.
explanation: Miniaturized astronomical observatory exploring missing baryonic matter.

name: SporeSat
description: Space biology investigation determining how plant cells sense gravity.
explanation: Autonomous microfluidic bio-sensor disc tracking calcium signaling in microgravity.

name: CXBN
description: Measure the cosmic X-ray background at 30 to 50 keV with high precision.
explanation: 2U astrophysics instrument resolving diffuse cosmic X-ray background radiation.

name: ChargerSat-1
description: Technology demos: gravity-gradient stabilization, deployable solar panels, antenna gain.
explanation: 1U multi-technology demonstration of deployables and stabilization systems.

name: ARMADILLO
description: 3U attitude maneuvers and space debris characterization in low orbit.
explanation: Small satellite orbital debris detector with cold-gas thruster maneuvers.

name: Dellingr
description: 6U CubeSat carrying heliophysics instruments to sample space weather in LEO.
explanation: Robust 6U platform proving resilient architecture for NASA scientific smallsats.

name: Fox-1
description: Education and amateur radio communications FM transponder package.
explanation: High-reliability amateur transponder providing global student outreach.
